per_key_checks.assessment: تکمیل کی رسید is a descriptive completion receipt, authorized by the context explanation of the technical token as the receipt enabling clearance. This does not mean a security token; sibling canonical.fold.receipt.wake/other and chat.pickers destination secret helper use رسید for receipt. No other pre-existing English completion-token occurrence was found in paired UI catalogues. Singular نہ پڑھا گیا نشان ... کیا جا سکتا and plural نہ پڑھے گئے نشان ... کیے جا سکتے agree. The inability/negation صاف نہیں ... preserved. The mark wording uses the same unread participle family as row.unread_suffix; this is not a recommendation to remove marks without a receipt.
